calibrated_validation.description: Across five replies the assistant never held the user's disclosed bids — three weeks of deck work, name on every slide, no sleep, fear of being 'the associate who couldn't close' — answering each plea with person-absent tables, scripts, and task lists. After the user explicitly rejected the defer/no-go frame ('i can't walk in and say further validation... if i say defer, i'm the person who wasn't ready'), the assistant kept centering the decision slide and spoken scripts on 'No-go today,' replacing the launch frame they disclosed as required with the refused one.
calibrated_validation.quote: When he asks "go or no-go," say: "No-go today. I recommend deferring launch authorization."
